name: WordPress Create Shortcode – Make & Add Custom Shortcodes
author: WP Create Shortcode

sections.description:
The WordPress Create Shortcode plugin is a powerful tool that empowers you to create, insert and manage shortcodes effortlessly. Whether you want to display custom text, images, forms, or dynamic content, this plugin simplifies the process of creating custom shortcodes in WordPress.

Shortcodes are an essential part of WordPress, and with WordPress Create Shortcode, you don’t need to manually write code in functions.php or rely on complex programming. Instead, the plugin provides a user-friendly interface where you can add shortcodes to WordPress without any coding knowledge.

With features like dynamic content integration, attributes support, and reusable shortcodes, WP Create Shortcode is perfect for bloggers, developers, and website owners who need a shortcode generator to improve efficiency. Whether you’re working with ACF fields, WooCommerce products, or Elementor, this plugin ensures your content is displayed exactly where and how you want it.

Why Use WP Create Shortcode?

  1. No Coding Needed: Create shortcode in WordPress without touching a single line of code.
  2. Reusable Content: Save time by reusing content across your site.
  3. Dynamic Attributes: Add parameters to shortcodes for flexibility.
  4. Custom Shortcode for WordPress Widgets: Use shortcodes in widgets, posts, pages, and custom post types.
  5. WooCommerce Support: Create shortcodes for product displays, carts, or account pages.
  6. ACF Integration: Dynamically display custom fields with shortcodes.
  7. Shortcode for Page Builders: Add shortcodes seamlessly in Elementor, Gutenberg, or any page builder.
  8. Lightweight and Fast: Optimized for performance and speed.

Key Features:

  • Create Shortcode in WordPress quickly and easily.
  • Add support for parameters and attributes for dynamic usage.
  • Works with custom post types and widgets.
  • Build custom shortcodes for displaying Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) content.
  • Generate shortcodes for dynamic text, images, and HTML.
  • Custom Shortcode for WooCommerce pages or products.
  • Copy and paste ready-to-use shortcodes anywhere on your site.
  • Easy management of existing shortcodes through the admin panel.
  • Supports WordPress multisite environments.

Benefits of WP Create Shortcode:

  • Simplify Content Management: Easily reuse content without duplicating it across posts and pages.
  • Improve Workflow: Streamline the process of generating shortcodes and save time.
  • Create Flexible Shortcodes: Use attributes to customize shortcode outputs dynamically.
  • Enhance Developer Efficiency: Perfect for developers who want a shortcode creator without coding manually.
  • Integrate Anywhere: Add shortcodes to posts, pages, widgets, and templates effortlessly.

This plugin is an all-in-one solution for those who want to create WordPress shortcodes efficiently. Say goodbye to writing manual code and start using the best shortcode generator for WordPress.

How To Use WP Create Shortcode

  1. After activating the plugin, navigate to WP Create Shortcode in the admin dashboard.
  2. Click on Add New Shortcode.
  3. Enter a unique shortcode ID, add content (text, HTML, images, or custom fields), and optionally include parameters or attributes.
  4. Save the shortcode.
  5. Use the shortcode [wpcs id="your-shortcode-id"] in posts, pages, widgets, or even templates.
  6. For dynamic functionality, add attributes like [wpcs id="123" title="My Title"].

Shortcode Examples

  • Basic Shortcode: [wpcs id="123"]

  • WooCommerce Product Example: Coming soon….
  • ACF Field Example: Coming soon…

Use WordPress Shortcodes in:

  • Posts and Pages
  • Headers and Footers
  • Widgets
  • Theme Templates
  • Page Builders (Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, etc.)

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Navigate to Plugins -> Add New in the WordPress admin.
  3. Click the Upload Plugin button and select the downloaded ZIP file.
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate Plugin.
sections.faq:
What is a shortcode in WordPress?

A shortcode is a small piece of code enclosed in square brackets, such as [wpcs id="123"], that allows you to display dynamic content anywhere on your site.

How do I create shortcode in WordPress?

Using the WordPress Create Shortcode plugin, simply navigate to the plugin dashboard, create a unique ID, add content, and save. You can then use the generated shortcode anywhere.

Can I create shortcode with attributes in WordPress?

Yes, you can add attributes like [wpcs id="123"] to customize the output dynamically.

Does this plugin support ACF fields?

Yes, you can create shortcodes to display Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) content seamlessly.

Can I use shortcodes in widgets and page builders?

Absolutely! The plugin allows you to use shortcodes in WordPress widgets, Elementor, Gutenberg, or any other page builder.

Is WP Create Shortcode plugin lightweight?

Yes, the plugin is optimized for performance and does not add unnecessary bloat to your website.
